01 / The system

What each kit includes

One box, one hardware and accessories kit for one enclosure. Glass is not included.

01

The model hardware

Profiles, handles, seals and opening or fixing parts, according to the configuration.

02

Two options for the glass

Order the glass from us separately, or have it cut to size by your local glazier. Confirm the kit’s technical sheet first.

03

Complete option

If you would rather receive the enclosure with glass, ask us about the complete configuration.

A complete enclosure is also available on request.

Shower enclosure kits. Made-to-measure glass.
